ruleset_title: Use the official title of the controlling publication or event manual.

official_source_url: Link the official source rather than an unsourced summary.
event_or_local_amendment: Record event, conference, state, league, school, sponsor, broadcaster, or organizer instructions that modify or add to the main ruleset.
review_owner: Name the person or role checking the source and artwork.
approval_authority: Name the team, league, event, official, compliance owner, or other authority that can approve the uniform.
uniform_role: Use primary jersey, alternate, libero, warm-up, bottom, undergarment, staff, or another defined role.
player_or_position: Use a coded player or role; keep personal information in an access-controlled roster.
front_artwork_revision: Use the released front artwork revision.
back_artwork_revision: Use the released back artwork revision.
bottom_revision: Use the released short, tight, legging, or other bottom revision.
jersey_base_colors: Record all dominant and secondary jersey colors as reviewed.
number_outline_or_border: Record outline or border treatment separately; do not assume it changes the controlling contrast decision.
front_number_spec: Link the reviewed front number dimensions, position, type, color, and artwork evidence.
back_number_spec: Link the reviewed back number dimensions, position, type, color, and artwork evidence.
libero_contrast_review: Record front and back libero comparison against every team colorway under the controlling ruleset; use TO CONFIRM until approved.
logo_sponsor_patch_scope: Record team, manufacturer, sponsor, conference, memorial, flag, crest, or other mark dimensions and positions that need review.
player_name_scope: Record whether a player name is used and the controlling source, size, position, and approval.
undergarment_and_equipment_scope: Record applicable color, identity, safety, equipment, compression, sleeve, tight, sock, knee-pad, or other instructions from the current source.
garment_fit_route: Name women, men, youth, adult, unisex, adaptive, short, tall, or another project-specific fit route without treating the label as proof of compliance.
size_scope: Name the sizes represented and the rule for scaling or holding artwork dimensions.
sample_id: Identify the physical sample used for review.
sample_type: Use artwork proof, strike-off, size sample, pre-production sample, packed sample, or another defined stage.
front_evidence: Link a straight-on identified front view under the agreed condition.
back_evidence: Link a straight-on identified back view under the agreed condition.
side_and_movement_evidence: Link side, sleeve, tucked or untucked, and representative movement evidence where relevant.
measurement_check: Link the garment and artwork measurement sheet and method.
artwork_scale_by_size: Record how artwork position and dimensions were checked on representative small and large garments.
roster_number_check: Confirm unique player numbers and the current roster revision before release.
pack_label_check: Confirm player, style, colorway, size, number, libero role, and pack label against the released roster.
issue_description: State the observed rule, artwork, sample, roster, or evidence conflict without guessing.
decision_or_action: Record revise, resubmit, approved exception, hold, reject, replace, recheck, or another authorized action.
release_status: Use draft, under review, hold, approved for sample, approved for production, rejected, or closed.
next_review_date: Use YYYY-MM-DD and recheck after a ruleset, event, roster, artwork, supplier, or product change.
notes: This worksheet does not certify legality, reproduce every rule, approve a uniform, or replace current official rulebooks, interpretations, event manuals, qualified officials, legal advice, physical samples, or written authorization.
